latest.title: Geometric finiteness in paracomplex hyperbolic spaces
latest.abstract: We develop a framework for studying discrete subgroups of $\mathsf{PGL}(d+1,\mathbb{R})$ via the paracomplex hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}_τ^d$, a rank-$1$ pseudo-Riemannian symmetric space. We characterize projective transverse, relatively Anosov, and Anosov subgroups in terms of properly discontinuous, geometrically finite, and convex-cocompact actions respectively on their weak hulls, which are canonical flow spaces in the spacelike unit tangent bundle of $\mathbb{H}_τ^d$. A key ingredient is the construction of a Busemann-type horofunction on the spacelike unit tangent bundle with the properties needed to describe cuspidal geometry. We further prove for relatively Anosov subgroups that the geodesic flows on their weak hulls are uniformly hyperbolic, giving a relative analogue of the Axiom A property.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 用副复双曲空间弱凸包刻画射影横截、相对 Anosov 与 Anosov 群，并证明相对情形流一致双曲。
latest.breakthrough: 把多个表示性质统一为几何有限作用。
latest.limitations: 发生在类空单位切丛的流空间，不能混同通常黎曼凸包。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
